topic: How do Doppler effects in LEO satellite systems impact UAV link budget calculations for high-mobility operations?
consensus_response: Doppler effects in LEO satellite systems introduce frequency shifts due to satellite movement and user terminal mobility, affecting signal propagation. These frequency shifts cause errors in link budget calculations, reducing the effective signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) by approximately 1-3 dB. This necessitates higher transmit power or more robust coding schemes to maintain reliable communication links for high-mobility UAV operations. The Doppler shift also introduces differential delay between carriers, causing inter-symbol interference (ISI) and reducing system throughput.
